claims.text: University A will inflate requests if it anticipates cuts.
claims.limit: Synthetic didactic data (Marco, Appendix E); not an observation of any real institution.

intent.capability: A can file requests unilaterally in the booking system.
intent.will: Inferred from one past cycle in which A's requests rose before a cut; not observed as a decision.

actors.preference: Keep the consortium intact with minimal conflict.
actors.representation: Acts for the three member universities under the consortium agreement.
actors.commitment_capacity: Can adopt allocation criteria; cannot add capacity without member budgets.
actors.affected_by: Loses legitimacy if criteria favour the strongest member.

actors.preference: Maximise hours for its own projects.
actors.representation: Its research office represents A's teams.
actors.commitment_capacity: Can commit its teams to the criteria; cannot commit funders.
actors.affected_by: Bears most deferred hours under a priority rule.

actors.preference: Predictable schedules and protected maintenance windows.
actors.commitment_capacity: Commits hours actually usable; cannot decide priorities.

actors.preference: Access when their experiments need it.
actors.representation: Each team speaks for its own project only.
actors.commitment_capacity: Can accept a slot; cannot reallocate others.

dependencies.substitution_time: four to six weeks to qualify an external lab

formal_vs_effective: Formally the council decides; in practice informal bookings by senior teams pre-empt the calendar.
